name: Remote Detonation (Snarecrafter)
text:
Brastlewark snarecrafters know that sometimes it's more advantageous to magically destroy a snare before it's triggered. Choose a magical snare within 120 feet that you crafted. The snare is automatically destroyed and each creature in a 5-foot emanation takes 1d6 force damage per level of the destroyed snare with a basic basic Reflex save save against the higher of your class DC or spell DC.

---
Special If you detonate a broad snare or giant snare, choose one square that snare occupies to be the center of the emanation.
